scope: Primary documentation review and selected read-only API probe. Only PVGIS PVcalc was live-tested; other connectors are proposed and require adapter acceptance.

sources.title: PVGIS overview and public beta notice
sources.used_for: PVGIS 6 is offered for testing; do not silently change the pinned production adapter.

sources.title: PVGIS 5 API
sources.used_for: Versioned server-side API, parameters, units, limits and CORS restrictions. Three v5_3 PVcalc requests were tested.

sources.title: PVGIS 5 user manual
sources.used_for: SARAH3 2005–2023; provider timestamp and TMY conventions. The detailed hourly explanation also retains older SARAH names; validate the exact selected product.

sources.title: ECMWF Reanalysis v5
sources.used_for: Long historical hourly atmospheric reconstruction; reanalysis is not a site measurement.

sources.title: ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present
sources.used_for: Higher-resolution land reconstruction and documented uncertainty; dataset-specific accumulation conversion.

sources.title: Single Runs API
sources.used_for: ECMWF IFS original runs from March 2024; preserve initialisation and assumed availability, not a stitched hindcast.

sources.title: Historical Weather API
sources.used_for: Explicit ERA5/ERA5-Land model selection and hourly conventions.

sources.title: Pricing and use terms
sources.used_for: Free service is non-commercial; commercial historical/ensemble/single-run access needs an appropriate plan. Data licence and API access are distinct.

sources.title: Solar radiation services
sources.used_for: Historical global/direct/diffuse radiation since 2004; satellite coverage and atmospheric inputs.

sources.title: CLCplus Backbone 2023
sources.used_for: 10 m European land-cover raster; observed cover does not establish use permission or ownership.

sources.title: Copernicus Contributing Missions documentation
sources.used_for: GLO-30 is a 30 m digital surface model including vegetation and structures, not a parcel survey.

sources.title: Natura 2000 viewer disclaimer
sources.used_for: The viewer describes the 2024 network; country submissions and sensitive-feature omissions matter.

sources.title: Natura 2000 spatial service
sources.used_for: Queryable spatial service; exact version, jurisdiction and coverage must be frozen.

sources.title: Access Natural England maps and data
sources.used_for: MAGIC and downloadable national environmental layers; England is not the whole UK.

sources.title: Cadastral parcels specification
sources.used_for: Common spatial specification; national geometry, rights and access remain separate.

sources.title: River flood hazard maps for Europe and the Mediterranean
sources.used_for: Modelled water depths for return periods 10–500 years; river basins >150 km². Explicitly not an official flood-hazard map; CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Seasonal Water Exploitation Index plus at sub-unit level
sources.used_for: 2023 edition published January 2026, temporal coverage 2000–2023; seasonal catchment pressure, not an abstraction entitlement.

sources.title: Aqueduct 4.0 data
sources.used_for: August 2023 framework; baseline and future water-risk indicators. WRI describes this as prioritisation requiring local investigation.

sources.title: Industrial Emissions Portal datasets
sources.used_for: Facility locations and reported annual emissions; not a CO₂ supply offer, gas assay or captured-volume dataset.

sources.title: Network data and development plans
sources.used_for: Indicative EHV network headroom and future scenarios; not a reserved import/export connection.

sources.title: How to get an API security token
sources.used_for: Authenticated API access path; do not embed tokens in exports or browser code.

sources.title: Transparency data extraction implementation guide
sources.used_for: Market/bidding-zone documents including day-ahead prices; preserve native resolution and publication.

sources.title: Insights API Developer Portal
sources.used_for: GB operational and settlement data; imbalance/system prices are not a site electricity tariff.

sources.title: e·sios API documentation
sources.used_for: Spanish market/context data; token access and explicit publication dates.

sources.title: System capacity maps
sources.used_for: European transmission context. Map disclaimer restricts use to indicative information and disclaims commercial-use reliance; keep as a reference, not an assumed reusable commercial layer.

sources.title: Technology Data for Renewable Fuels
sources.used_for: Live page links August 2026 catalogue/data sheets; scale, technology, currency year and uncertainty must accompany any imported benchmark.

sources.title: Renewable hydrogen
sources.used_for: Additionality and temporal/geographic correlation affect renewable-fuel eligibility; not a certification implemented by this design.

sources.title: Weather DataHub observations overview
sources.used_for: Recent hourly station measurements; this API has a 48-hour historical window, not a long-term site calibration archive.

sources.title: 10-minute solar observations dataset description
sources.used_for: Station radiation and quality metadata; use identified representative stations, not sunshine duration as irradiance.

sources.title: Regional hydrogen and Power-to-X ecosystems
sources.used_for: HYSCOPE / geo-techno-economic analysis combines location, scale, operation and supply chains.

sources.publisher: NREL / National Laboratory of the Rockies
sources.title: REopt user manual
sources.used_for: Techno-economic and resilience design pattern; US-oriented defaults are not European methane-plant inputs.

sources.title: Calculate land-use availabilities
sources.used_for: Explicit exclusion masks and renewable-potential calculation; reuse GIS patterns, keep plant kernels.

sources.title: About Renewables.ninja
sources.used_for: Hourly renewable modelling and validation work; separate commercial-data terms.

sources.title: Quantifying Uncertainty in PV Energy Estimates, final report and errata
sources.used_for: Separates resource variability from performance uncertainty and defines exceedance probabilities. Use its corrected method, not unreviewed defaults.

sources.title: Time series aggregation for energy system design: Modeling seasonal storage
sources.used_for: 2018 Applied Energy study, DOI 10.1016/j.apenergy.2018.01.023; inter-period storage states matter for representative-period design.

sources.title: MapLibre GL JS
sources.used_for: Browser vector-map rendering; tiles and data have separate licences.

sources.title: Tile usage policy
sources.used_for: The public raster tile service prohibits bulk/offline prefetch; select a suitable provider or licensed local data.

sources.title: Copyright and licence
sources.used_for: Road/vector data is ODbL with attribution and database obligations; data rights are distinct from hosted tiles, geocoding and routing services.

sources.title: Terms of use
sources.used_for: Public-domain low-resolution geography suitable for the offline overview; not cadastral boundaries.
